notes: Policy snapshots are candidates, not permanent guarantees. Recheck the linked official rules before posting. The agent never auto-posts into third-party communities.

channels.name: Bluesky brand feed
channels.fit: Best first owned channel for concise engineering explainers and course links.
channels.cost: No-cost organic posting; current API has no published usage fee in the posting docs.
channels.automation: API publisher implemented; requires a separate brand account and app password.
channels.limits: One scheduled post per UTC day in this MVP; avoid repetitive or misleading content.

channels.name: Udemy Promotional Email
channels.fit: Strong for offering another relevant Udemy course to learners already enrolled in one of your courses.
channels.cost: Included Udemy instructor tool; no separate ad spend.
channels.automation: Not integrated; send inside Udemy Instructor tools.
channels.limits: Udemy currently allows up to two promotional emails per course per month, only to students of a course where you are a visible instructor; emails may include Udemy course links/coupons but not external links.

channels.name: YouTube educational video/channel
channels.fit: Useful for searchable engineering demonstrations and previews; requires creating substantive video content.
channels.cost: Organic channel is free; video production may take time; API access uses quota.
channels.automation: Not integrated. YouTube Data API supports uploads, but requires OAuth/channel setup.
channels.limits: Use useful original educational content; avoid repetitive/automated mass-produced uploads, comment spam, or videos made only to push external traffic. External links are clickable only in supported locations and with required channel features.

channels.name: Hackaday.io project page
channels.fit: Potential fit when you have a real engineering build, prototype, or detailed project write-up related to a course topic.
channels.cost: Public project sharing appears free; confirm current account/feature terms.
channels.automation: Not integrated; publish a substantive project manually.
channels.limits: Treat as project documentation, not a bare course-ad channel. Current self-promotion rules need a fresh check before adding any course CTA.

channels.name: Instructables tutorial
channels.fit: Potential fit for a complete, reproducible engineering build/tutorial that is useful on its own.
channels.cost: Public project publishing appears free; confirm current account/feature terms.
channels.automation: Not integrated; create a detailed tutorial manually.
channels.limits: Publish an original how-to with steps, media, and files; verify current link and promotion rules before mentioning a course.

channels.name: Robotics Stack Exchange
channels.fit: Useful for discovering real robotics questions and topic demand.
channels.automation: Scout signal only; no promotional answers, comments, or DMs.
channels.limits: Q&A is for solving specific problems; avoid overt self-promotion and disclose affiliation when a relevant product/site is mentioned.

channels.name: Udemy Instructor Community
channels.fit: Useful for instructor support and peer discussion, not course customer acquisition.
channels.limits: Udemy's community policy prohibits self-promotion and affiliate links.
